name: FiguRobot
summary: FiguRobot is a Shanghai company developing desktop humanoid robots and companion AI hardware. It combines miniature articulated bodies with voice, expression and motion interaction, and offers software for personalizing robot characters and behavior. Its official product range includes the Nian NIA-FR02 desktop humanoid and related AI companion devices.
